name: quran-data
_comment_deps: Story 5-1 review: this package declared NOTHING while running `jest` and `tsc`, relying entirely on pnpm hoisting them from other workspaces. Under `nodeLinker: hoisted` that works until it does not — a version bump elsewhere silently changes what runs here. Declared explicitly instead. ⚠️ Story 5-7 finished the job: `jest.config.js` uses `preset: 'ts-jest'`, so `ts-jest` and `@types/jest` are load-bearing too and were STILL being hoisted from apps/expo. It passed on a developer machine and failed on the first CI run with `Cannot find name 'expect'` — a clean checkout hoists differently than an incrementally-installed tree.
